content: How do I change the window/level in the CT viewer?
Documentation: 5 passage(s) for 'CT viewer window/level adjustment'

Left-drag in any of the CT viewer views to change the window/level. The other mouse controls are:

- Mouse wheel: change slice.
- Middle drag: pan.
- Right drag: zoom.The viewer starts with the window/level stored by the scanner.CochleaHub doesn't choose one. The documentation doesn't mention a reset button or presets. I can't say whether either exists.
